title: Tree
description: A phylogenetic (or other hierarchical) tree node, shared by picea, react-bio-viz, acacia, and iqtreeserver. The root of a tree is itself a Tree node; a whole tree and a single node use the same shape.

id.description: Optional node identifier. Not every producer assigns one at parse time (acacia/iqtreeserver derive ids separately); consumers must not assume it is present.

name.description: Raw node label: a leaf name, or an internal-node label such as a bootstrap value or support string (e.g. picea's "0.989", IQ-TREE's "95.3/88"). Kept as the original string for round-tripping; parse further only if you know the producer's convention.

length.description: Branch length leading to this node.

children.description: Child nodes. Empty array for a leaf.
